summary: Iteration 2 focused on the two new features: Referral Rewards + Google Sign-In. Backend: 9/9 new pytest cases passed against the public preview URL, covering (a) new OTP user object contains referral_code, (b) referring user A goes 5 -> 15 when user B signs up with A's code, (c) no double reward on repeated verify-otp by B, (d) self-referral is a no-op (balance stays 5), (e) invalid/unknown referral code is silently ignored and B still gets 5 free credits, (f) GET /api/referral/me returns referral_code, reward_per_referral=10, total_referred, total_reward_credits and referrals[] for user A after 2 sign-ups, (g) POST /api/auth/google-session with an invalid session_id returns 401, (h) missing session_id returns 422, (i) regression: profile/me and template download still work. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login screen renders mobile input, 'Have a referral code?' toggle expands to reveal referral input, 'Continue with Google' button renders and is tappable (Google OAuth full flow NOT exercised - only presence + no crash verified). Full OTP login with referral code entered navigated correctly: Login -> OTP screen -> onboarding (for new user). For existing user A, login skipped onboarding and landed on home showing '15 Templates Remaining' (5 free + 10 referral). Profile tab -> Refer & Earn navigates to /referral screen and displays: referral code (e.g. NSFA91BB), 'Give & Get 10 Templates' hero, Copy + Share buttons, and stats (1 Advocates Invited, 10 Templates Earned). Copy button flips to 'Copied' state on tap. Deprecated packages detected: NONE. SafeAreaView issues detected: NONE.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: The Google OAuth 'success' path (valid session_id) was not exercised headlessly — verify manually with a real Emergent-managed Google account before shipping to confirm new-user creation via provider='google', is_new flag, and that a referral_code passed from the login screen actually reaches /api/auth/google-session (currently useGoogleAuth passes it — spot-check on device).
Prior-iteration polish items still open: React Native Web `pointerEvents` prop deprecation warning + low-contrast floating labels on Login/OTP TextInput.
critical_code_review_comments: apply_referral() correctly guards against self-referral (referrer.id == new_user.id) and duplicate reward (referrals collection lookup by referred_user_id). Rewards are $inc atomic and idempotent — good.
gen_referral_code() retries up to 10 times before falling back to a 4-byte code — collision-safe.
GET /api/referral/me back-fills a referral_code for legacy users on first read via update_one — good migration strategy.

google-session upserts on lowercased email and passes referral_code to apply_referral only for new users — correct behavior. Note that if a returning Google user retries with a friend's code, that code is silently dropped (by design — matches OTP behaviour where re-login doesn't award).

server.py is now 698 lines (was 568). It has crossed the 700-line soft cap threshold and should be split into routers/{auth,referral,catalog,cases,templates,applications,wallet,drafts}.py in a future refactor.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 new + prior 31/31 regression suite still exists)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for exercised flows — login screen render, referral toggle, OTP referral pass-through, referral screen render + code + copy + share + stats. Google OAuth success path not headlessly testable (Emergent-managed).

seed_data_creation: None manually seeded. Test users created dynamically via unique 10-digit mobile numbers per test. Cleanup relies on TEST_ prefixing and per-user isolation.
